$comment: One tutor's record: who they are, what they teach, where, and how the site and its emails name them. Inês is the only tutor for now; the booking Worker and the site both read this file instead of spelling her details out. Rules a tutor changes day to day (notice, prices, buffer, horizon, fees) stay in the Worker's settings table, which wins over the defaults below.
name: Inês Dias Baía

language.name: Portuguese

phrases.willReview: A Inês vai rever esta resposta.
phrases.compareWithSheet: Compara com a resposta da ficha.

language.aiStyle: Use Portuguese as spoken and written in Portugal, current orthography, natural local vocabulary and grammar; use tu consistently for learner instructions.
language.aiMarkingStyle: Preserve meaningful accents and Portugal vocabulary/grammar.

features.$comment: Expressions is an add-on for Inês's site only, not part of the platform (9 November 2026, Dan). Homework and lesson notes are hidden on her pages and students' while homework is false (11 November 2026, Dan: hide homework for now); nothing is deleted, and true brings them back.

bookings.$comment: Never change these for a tutor with lessons: calendars match updates by the UID's domain, and students and receipts quote the reference prefix.
